reason: This is the only offered combination, and it connects the larger lymph vessels to a vein.

effect: The larger lymph vessels now connect to a vein, with valves limiting backward flow. The collecting vessels still need to join that route.
reaction: The valve panels make the direction of fluid movement clear.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it should connect fluid collection to the return route.
expectation: I expect fluid from around the cells to travel through the lymph vessels and return to the vein.

effect: The lymph vessels now form a continuous route from around cells to the neck vein; it still needs connecting to the supplied body.
reaction: It helped to see where the fluid becomes lymph and how it returns.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should connect the return route to the body.
expectation: I expect the body model to show lymph draining from tissue spaces back into the blood.

effect: The completed model connects lymph return to the supplied body and shows fluid levels staying roughly steady.
reaction: Seeing the separate outgoing and return routes together made the purpose of lymph drainage clearer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the draining tissue spaces to the return route was most worthwhile: it showed the complete path back to the vein and explained when the fluid is called lymph.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished lymph network to the body felt a little repetitive after the full return route had already been shown.

surprise.text: I was surprised that fluid leaving blood vessels has a separate route back to the blood, and that it becomes lymph when it enters those vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The last few choices were the only offered combinations, but their purposes were clear from the goals and pictures.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: connecting familiar systems to the less familiar lymph route was interesting, though the final assembly was predictable.
